title: A Sigil for the Garden
author: Zephyrine Thornbury
blurb: Lena Villalobos, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
